caveats: All cases are copies of ONE genuine paired tile (ice-s-0001-0002); cases share pixels and are not independent samples. Results do not generalize to other regions or to the Moon.
Faults are synthetic corruptions of genuine data, not real lunar anomalies.
The statistical unit is the case, never the pixel; no confidence intervals are reported.
Metrics over a declared subset (e.g. a one-case pilot) are feasibility checks, not a performance comparison.
Token counts are provider-reported; no price is applied (unpriced).
Fault expectations were pre-registered by the author of the deterministic baseline; they are a plumbing check, not an independent difficulty estimate.
decision_rule: A case is FLAGGED iff at least one agent's LATEST submit_assessment verdict is 'fault_suspected' (every assessment cites >= 1 measurement event). If no agent filed an assessment the case is NOT flagged and is reported as decision_missing. The deterministic baseline flags a case iff any pre-registered rule triggers (PairedBaselineConfig).
